posts.name: Reverend Pete
posts.cooked:
Mint.

 

Key for me was getting out an Infrared Eyepiece ASAP.  Omnitron (like most villains) isn't nearly as much of a threat if you can keep the nasty cards away.

Haka had fun with Punish the Weak, Absolute Zero mostly skipped his turn to keep the Self-destruct Sequence at bay, Bunker drew a bazillion cards via Ammo Drop, Fanatic Emboldened Haka, and Wraith Eyepieced like it was going out of style.

I did manage to win by destroying a Cryo Chamber, which is a card I rarely play! Fun times!

posts.name: LewdDolphin21
posts.cooked:
Mint! I Emboldened Bunker, which with Heavy Plating, Flak Cannon, and Maintenance Unit resulted in a profit of 1 HP while still dealing 3 projectile damage. In my last turn I replaced the HP recovery with a 12-damage Omni-Cannon, which was sick.

Infra-red Eyepiece is so vital to prevent Omnitron from destroying your stuff. I successfully managed to bury both Technological Singularities and the second Sedative Flachettes that way. I also didn't see a Pervasive Red Dust, perhaps due to having played two Adhesive Foam Grenades. Thus my match was not at all hero-threatening.

posts.name: Melkhor
posts.cooked:
Got what ended up as a comfortable Mint here at the end, though it still felt more than a little hairy as the four cards left in Omnitron's deck when he finally went offline were: Technological Singularity, Terraforming and Electro-Pulse Explosive x2.

I didn't manage to dodge the first singularity, but thankfully, a Meteor Storm was up to at least shield me from the damage, and I think the Pervasive Red Dust hit me no less than 3 times!

posts.name: Arcanist Lupus
posts.cooked:
Mint.  No Infrared Eyepiece here - just a brutal smack down.  I timed a Throat Jab to shield us from the first Technological Singularity, but it still hurt.  Game ended after a round of Divine Focus, a 14 card Haka of Battle (which nearly killed me, because Interpolation Beam was out, Haka was at 4, and Omnitron was getting +1, which I had forgotten about.  Fortunately, I had left Smoke Bombs out for just this eventuality), and a 3 card Inventory Barrage won the day.  

Actually, Fanatic killed herself to keep her Divine Focus out, but she was wearing her Aegis of Resurrection, so she got better.

posts.name: Donner
posts.cooked: I got mint despite a bug with Pervasive Red Dust forcing me to get hit by it 3 times before I could get rid of it properly.  (Hint:  Have the only equipment in a character's trash also be in play).  I had to exit the game, start it again, and it would do Pervasive Red Dust and I had to choose not to discard cards.  This happened twice. :(  Needless to say it was a VERY long game.

Mint.

Inventing a new and improved Infrared eye piece allowed me to keep Omniton's worst cards buried. I played as much equipment as I could just in case Pervasive Red Dust appeared, but as it didn't I'm really glad I buried both Technological Singularities. Once The Wraith and Bunker were setup, it became a cake walk. Everyone ended with about 20hp.

posts.name: The Burning Stickman
posts.cooked: Mint. Yeah, this one was pretty straightforward -- Infrared Eye-Piece FTW. My only (extremely) minor misstep was trying to use AZ's base power to attack when I had the Cryo Chamber out, so I wasted a phase, but aside from that, no real surprises. Though I did get more use out of Punish the Weak than I usually do. Which is to say I usually don't bother with it, but it was handy for getting over the DR advanced mode brings.
